label: D35-undangan-berkartu-menyetujui-instance-belum-selesai
decision: A device redeems a valid, unexpired invitation that the operator bound to registered physical card A, while the same device already holds an unfinished card instance for card A (PENDING_APPROVAL, or PROVISIONING without a credential), typically created earlier through the card path. Today the server answers 409 ENR-DUPLICATE, which is a dead end. What should POST /v1/enrollments do in this case?

candidates.description: Return the existing unfinished instance unchanged with HTTP 200 and its current status (PENDING_APPROVAL stays pending until the operator approves via CLI; PROVISIONING continues). The invitation is not consumed and no audit event is written.

Treat the invitation as the operator's approval of the existing instance: in the same transaction set it to PROVISIONING (if it was PENDING_APPROVAL), set invitation_id to this invitation, refresh status_changed_at, set the invitation's used_at, and append an audit event (enrollment.approved, actor device:<id>, data {method: invitation, invitation: <internal id>}). Return HTTP 200 with PROVISIONING. If the instance already belongs to another invitation, keep it and return it unchanged (resume) without consuming the new invitation.

Mark the existing unfinished instance ABANDONED (audit enrollment.abandoned with reason superseded) and create a new PROVISIONING instance with invitation_id and physical_card_id, consuming the invitation and appending enrollment.started {method: invitation}. Return HTTP 201 with the new enrollment_id.

Keep the 409 but with distinct codes: ENR-PENDING-APPROVAL when the existing instance is PENDING_APPROVAL, and a new ENR-IN-PROGRESS when it is PROVISIONING. The invitation is not consumed; the operator must still approve via CLI.

priorities: 1) No dead end: a device that holds an operator-issued invitation for card A must reach a credential without further operator action (ADR-0034's first priority). 2) Operator intent and audit traceability: the audit chain must show how the instance reached PROVISIONING and which invitation authorised it (FR-54). 3) Keep single use, the 8-card limit, and ADR-0032 unchanged for devices without an invitation. 4) Minimal code and API surface; no new error codes unless needed.
requirements: A device holding a PENDING_APPROVAL instance for card A that redeems a valid invitation bound to card A can obtain a credential without any further operator action.
Every status change of a card instance caused by redeeming the invitation is recorded in the audit chain together with the internal id of the invitation (FR-54).
After redemption the invitation is linked to at most one non-ABANDONED card instance, and the device's active-card count does not increase.
